title: Grateful Dead Live at Curtis Hixon Convention Hall on 1973-12-18
source: matrix of shnid 122508 (source 1 AUD) and shnid 116498 (source 2 SBD); matrixed by Monte Barry

ai_review.summary: Matrix recording captures great audience presence and a solid Weather Report Suite → Dark Star → Eyes of the World sequence.
ai_review.review: The matrix source delivers a lively blend of board clarity and crowd ambience, which reviewers praised as sounding good. The show’s highlight is the seamless flow from the Weather Report Suite into a smoking Dark Star and into Eyes of the World. Aside from a brief, non‑musical tribute comment, feedback is overwhelmingly positive about both performance and recording.

ai_rating.rationale: One enthusiastic 5‑star review praises the matrix sound and Dark Star segment; a second terse comment gives no substantive rating, pulling the average down but not negating the overall positive impression.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note the matrix captures audience presence and sounds good; no specific complaints about muddiness or drop‑outs.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows well, with the Weather Report Suite leading into a strong Dark Star and concluding with Eyes of the World, creating an engaging musical arc.
